hook.name: RallyHookU4
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a bonding curve token launch platform. Acts as the sole liquidity provider, enforces a dynamic anti-snipe fee that decays over time, and charges quote-denominated fees on sells via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Transitions pools from CURVE to BREAKOUT phase when the price target is reached.
